description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Consumer Affairs Authority Act No. 09 of 2003 (Amended) Order Under Section 18 L.P. Gas Essential to the Life of Community
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order issued by the Minister under Section 18 of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 (Amended), prescribing Liquefied Petroleum Gas as "specified goods." This constitutes a regulatory action and legal instrument under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
